name.value: During a week, the general public will be invited to Enghien-les-Bains’s Centre des arts for an immersive journey into the heart of Havana, a city shaped by five centuries of historical and cultural exchange. The rich and varied programme featuring screenings, exhibitions, conferences, concerts, shows, and dance master classes, will celebrate the close cooperation established between the city of Enghien-les-Bains and Cuba over the past 20 years.
